info.title: MoboEats API
info.description: REST API for the MoboEats platform: customers (orderers), restaurants and grocery shops, riders and administrators.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description:
Endpoints for registering, logging in (email/password or phone OTP), logging out,
resetting passwords and fetching the authenticated user.

tags.name: Bookmarks
tags.description: Customer bookmarks (favourites) for menu items.

tags.name: Cart
tags.description: Customer shopping cart. Each orderer has at most one active cart.

tags.name: Countries
tags.description: Admin management of supported countries (`v1/admin/countries`).

tags.name: Customer Profile
tags.description: Customer (orderer) profile management.

tags.name: Diet Plans
tags.description: Diet subscription packages and user diet plan subscriptions.

tags.name: FAQs
tags.description: Frequently asked questions (`v1/frequently-asked-questions`).

tags.name: Food Categories
tags.description:
Food (menu) categories such as "Burgers" or "Groceries". Categories group menu items and own a set of
sub categories. Global categories have no `restaurant_id`; restaurant specific ones belong to a restaurant.

tags.name: Maps & Location
tags.description: Thin proxies to the Google Maps APIs. Responses are passed through unchanged from Google.

tags.name: Marketing
tags.description: Advert posters shown in the apps. Listing is public (`v1/ads`); management is under `v1/admin/marketing`.

tags.name: Menus
tags.description:
Restaurant menu items (dishes and grocery products): browsing for customers, and management (create, update,
images, prices, import/export, reviews) for restaurant owners. Grocery items are menu items in the "groceries" category.

tags.name: Messaging
tags.description: In-app chat between users (customers, riders, restaurants and the admin).

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: In-app (database) notifications for the authenticated user or their restaurants.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description:
Customer and restaurant order endpoints: placing orders and dine-in reservations, listing and viewing orders,
updating order/reservation status, assigning tables and riders, and exporting orders.

tags.name: Orphanages
tags.description:
Orphanages that customers can donate orders to. Public endpoints under `v1/orphanages`; admin endpoints under
`v1/admin/orphanages` (also duplicated under `v1/admin/v1/orphanages`).

tags.name: Payments
tags.description:
Payment endpoints: Stripe, M-Pesa (PochiPay) and PayPal checkouts for orders, rider tips,
supplement orders and diet plan subscriptions, plus the provider webhooks/callbacks that confirm payments.

tags.name: Promo Codes & Discounts
tags.description: Restaurant promo codes managed by restaurant owners/employees (`v1/restaurant/promo-codes`).

tags.name: Restaurant Management
tags.description:
Restaurant listings, details, registration and the restaurant owner/employee panel (dashboard, tables,
reservations, payments, categories, employees). Endpoints under `/v1/restaurant` (except registering a restaurant)
pass through the `has_restaurant` middleware, which returns `422 {"data":"no_restaurant"}` when a user with role
`restaurant` has not registered any restaurant yet.

tags.name: Riders
tags.description: Rider profile management, order delivery workflow, location tracking, earnings and tips.

tags.name: Supplements
tags.description:
Supplements, supplement categories, suppliers and supplement orders. Customer-facing
endpoints live under `v1/orderer/supplements`, admin endpoints under `v1/admin/supplements`.
